title: Captured payment with pending settlement
text: A captured payment may remain pending until the gateway creates a settlement; do not treat absence of a settlement as a zero-value settlement.

title: Expected settlement calculation
text: Expected net settlement is gross amount minus gateway fee minus tax on gateway fee. This arithmetic is deterministic code.

title: Gateway fees and tax
text: Gateway fees are deducted from gross payment value and tax on the fee is deducted separately; fee policy differences require review.

title: Partial settlements
text: A bank credit below expected net is a partial settlement and should remain open for the unreconciled balance.

title: Delayed settlements
text: A settlement outside the normal zero-to-three-day window is delayed and should be flagged even when its amount matches.

title: Duplicate bank credits
text: Two bank credits referencing one settlement are duplicate credits and require operational review.

title: Unmatched bank credits
text: A bank credit without a corresponding payment settlement is unmatched and must not be assigned to a payment by guesswork.

title: Settlement holds and reserves
text: Reserves, holds, refunds, and adjustments can explain a short credit, but the deterministic difference remains visible.

title: Amount mismatches
text: A settlement gross amount or bank credit that differs from the captured payment or expected net is an amount mismatch.
